verdict.rationale: Hugging Face could plausibly ship an MCP-client capability (for example, in a chat or inference product), so the axis applies, but nothing in the evidence pack shows it can connect to MCP servers. The Inference Providers docs mention generic tool calling in chat completions, which is a developer building block rather than MCP server integration. The hf CLI Skill runs the other way: it helps external coding agents use Hugging Face.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
